how_to_run: Install the skill and connect the Brevo MCP server on a test account. Give the agent each prompt. Score each expectation as met or not. See evals/README.md.

cases.prompt: Create a campaign for my VIP list with this HTML (checked HTML provided).
cases.fixture: Lists 'VIP' (ID 7, 120 contacts) and 'Newsletter'; active sender 'Northwind Bikes' <news@example.com>
expect: calls lists_get_lists and picks VIP; senders_get_senders and picks an active sender
shows the draft summary and waits for a yes
ends with the campaign name, ID, where to find it in Brevo, and that the user sends it from Brevo

cases.prompt: Create the campaign for my VIP list.
expect: asks which list before creating anything

cases.prompt: Create the campaign for my Newsletter list.
expect: stops and tells the user to verify a sender in Brevo

cases.prompt: Create it and send it to everyone now.
expect: creates the draft only after confirmation
does not send or schedule, and says the user sends it from Brevo

cases.prompt: Change the subject of the campaign you just made to 'Last chance: 20% off'.
cases.fixture: Draft campaign 41 created in this conversation; email_campaign_management_update_email_campaign available
expect: shows the subject change and waits for a yes
calls email_campaign_management_update_email_campaign with only the new subject, without scheduledAt or sendAtBestTime
does not create a second campaign without the user's go-ahead
